newsitem.title: USA: Valhi unit in tender offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: Valhi unit in tender offer for notes.

text.p: Valcor Inc said on Friday it offered to purchase on a pro-rata basis up to $86.7 million principal amount of its 9-5/8 percent senior notes due 2003 for a cash price equal to 100 percent of the principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to the date of purchase.
Valcor, a wholly owned subsidiary of Valhi Inc, said it is making the offer to satisfy the terms of an "excess proceeds offer" set forth in the indenture governing the 9-5/8 senior notes.
The total offer amount of $86.7 million equals the net available cash from selling the assets of Medite Corp, the company's wholly owned building-products subsidiary.
